message: Thanks. A few quick questions: (1) How many children under 18 live with you? (2) Is anyone pregnant, or is there a baby under 1? (3) Is anyone 65 or older? (4) Does anyone have a disability? (5) Roughly how much does the household earn from work in a year, before tax? (6) How much Social Security does the household get in a year? (7) Any other income a year (pensions, unemployment, interest, child support)? (8) Does anyone get health insurance through a job? (9) Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments?
reply: No kids. No. I'd have to check. Nope. Around 10 thousand a month. None. $66,400 a year. Yeah. 193 thousand.

summary: Household of 2 in Wisconsin, no children, owns home. About $120k earned plus $66.4k other income, $193k assets, employer insurance. Income and assets are too high for SNAP, Medicaid, SSI and EITC. No children means no WIC, CHIP, CTC, school meals or TANF. Employer coverage and income above 400% FPL rule out ACA premium credits.
